description:
This stunning property was built in 2023 and is presented in excellent condition throughout. Extending to approx. 124sqm/ 1,335 sq.ft., this turn key property has been decorated with stylish modern features, including wall panelling in the sitting room, open plan kitchen/ dining with intergrated appliances and all bathrooms have beautiful tiles floor to ceiling.

Externally, the property benefits from a paved area to the front for parking and a private rear garden.

This residence has been finished to a high stand and would make an ideal family home, close to amenities in Navan.

LOCATION
Rowleys Lock is a modern residential development conveniently located along the Boyne Road which is within easy reach of Navan Town Centre, with schools, shops, sporting facilities and a wide range of local amenities nearby. The M3 motorway is also readily accessible, providing convenient access towards Dublin.

Viewing highly recommended
